answer: Sybil resistance comes from a stake-bonded identity registry. Registering an agent requires locking a bond that grows with every identity already traced to the same funding wallet. A random quorum of existing bond holders signs off on each new claim, so one operator running a fleet of fakes cannot fake independent attestation; a failed audit burns part of the bond, a hard marble floor under the cost. Posing as a hundred agents means funding a hundred separate bonds, turning a cheap grind into a costly dune of locked capital, and the barrier repeats every epoch of the voyage, never amortizing.
